_help: Catálogo de servicios y productos de Devleck. La IA SOLO recomienda lo que esté aquí con active=true. Edítalo desde la interfaz (modo administrador) o con /nuevo-servicio en Claude Code, y luego súbelo al repo.

items.name: AI Receptionist & Booking Agent
items.oneLiner: An AI agent that answers calls, chats and web forms 24/7, qualifies the customer and books the appointment directly in the business calendar.
items.description: Omnichannel AI agent (phone, website chat, SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram DM) trained on the business's services, prices and policies. It answers questions, qualifies leads, books/reschedules appointments in the existing calendar/CRM and escalates to a human when needed. Built on Claude, integrated with the tools the business already uses.
deliverables: Voice + chat agent trained on the business
Dashboard with conversations and booked appointments

idealCustomer.companySize: 2–100 employees, appointment-driven, high inbound call volume
idealCustomer.description: Local service businesses that lose money when the phone isn't answered: after-hours calls, busy front desk, slow web-lead response.

buyingSignals: Reviews complaining about not answering the phone, voicemail full or slow replies
Job posts for receptionist / front desk / call center / scheduling coordinator
Website only has a contact form or 'call us' (no online booking, no chat)
Multiple locations or extended hours
Running Google/Facebook ads (paying for leads that may go unanswered)
disqualifiers: Already uses an AI receptionist/chatbot that books appointments
National chain with corporate call center

pricing.notes: Setup fee plus optional monthly maintenance; fixed price per phase.

items.roi: If they miss 10 calls/week and a new customer is worth $300, that's ~$150k/year walking to competitors. The agent pays for itself with 2–3 recovered customers a month.

pitch.hook: Most {niche} lose 1 in 4 calls after hours or when the front desk is busy — we build an AI receptionist that answers every call and books the appointment for you.
valueProps: Never miss a call or a web lead again
Costs less than a part-time receptionist
You own it — no per-seat SaaS
pitch.proof: Built on Claude by a senior engineering team; weekly demos so you see it working before you pay the next phase.

objections.objection: Customers want to talk to a human.
objections.response: Totally — the agent hands off to your team instantly for anything sensitive. It just makes sure nobody hits voicemail at 7 pm and calls your competitor instead.
Great — this isn't replacing her, it's covering lunch, after-hours, weekends and the moments she's on another line. How many calls do you think go to voicemail in a week?
It's a fixed setup, quoted after a free call. If it doesn't recover more than it costs in the first months, it's not worth doing — and we'll tell you that.

items.name: Back-Office Process Automation
items.oneLiner: We automate the repetitive work — invoicing, data entry, reconciliation, CRM/ERP sync, approvals — so the team stops copying data between systems.
items.description: Custom automations and internal tools that connect the systems a company already uses (QuickBooks, Xero, Salesforce, HubSpot, spreadsheets, ERPs, email) and remove manual steps: invoicing and reconciliation, order/inventory sync, document processing with AI, approval flows with digital signatures, reporting.

idealCustomer.description: Companies whose operations run on spreadsheets, email and double data entry, and whose admin headcount grows with revenue.

buyingSignals: Job posts for data entry, billing specialist, AP/AR clerk, dispatcher, admin assistant
Fast growth (new locations, hiring spree, new contracts) without new systems
Mentions of spreadsheets, paper forms, PDFs, fax or 'email us your documents'
Uses several disconnected tools (QuickBooks + CRM + spreadsheets)
disqualifiers: Fewer than 5 employees with almost no admin work
Has a large in-house IT/dev team
painPointsSolved: Hours lost to manual data entry
Systems that don't talk to each other

pricing.notes: A contained automation module is usually in the low thousands.

items.roi: 10 people × 5 hours/week of manual work × $25/hour ≈ $65,000/year and 2,600 hours reclaimed.

pitch.hook: We help {niche} stop paying people to copy data between systems — invoicing, dispatch, reconciliation, reports.
valueProps: Works with the tools you already have
pitch.proof: Free scoping call ends with a written brief and an ROI estimate — you decide with numbers.

objections.objection: We tried Zapier and it broke.
objections.response: That's common — no-code glue breaks at scale. We build it like real software: tested, monitored, documented, and you own it.
That's exactly why off-the-shelf tools fail for you. Custom is our whole business — we map your process first, then automate only what pays back.

items.name: Custom Web Platform / Customer Portal
items.oneLiner: Fast, modern web platforms, customer portals and internal tools built with Next.js — designed to scale and convert.
items.description: Custom web applications: customer portals (quotes, orders, tracking, documents), booking/ordering platforms, internal dashboards, marketplaces and SaaS MVPs. Built with Next.js/React, Node and PostgreSQL, with design system, SEO and performance included.

idealCustomer.description: Businesses whose customers still request quotes, orders or status updates by phone/email, or startups that need an MVP built by seniors.

buyingSignals: Customers must call or email for quotes, order status or documents
Outdated website (old copyright year, not mobile friendly, slow)
Recent funding round or new product launch
Job posts for a web developer / CTO (we can be the team instead)
disqualifiers: Has a strong in-house product team

pricing.notes: Full platform in the tens of thousands; MVP phases can start smaller.

items.roi: A self-service portal removes most status/quote calls and emails and lets the business sell 24/7.

pitch.hook: We build customer portals that let your clients get quotes, place orders and track status online — without calling your team.
pitch.proof: Next.js/React platforms engineered for real users and real load, not templates.

objections.response: Most of our clients do — the question is whether it does work for you. Can your customers get a quote or check an order without calling you?

objections.objection: We'd rather hire an in-house developer.
objections.response: One mid-level dev costs $100k+/year and takes months to hire. We give you a senior team for a fixed price per phase, and hand over everything documented if you hire later.

items.name: Mobile App (iOS + Android)
items.oneLiner: Cross-platform iOS and Android apps from a single codebase — loyalty, ordering, booking, field-team apps.
items.description: React Native apps for customers (ordering, booking, loyalty, memberships) or for field teams (inspections, deliveries, time tracking, photos, signatures), connected to the company's backend.

idealCustomer.companySize: Multi-location businesses or companies with field teams
idealCustomer.description: Brands with recurring customers who would use an app, or companies with crews in the field using paper or WhatsApp.

buyingSignals: Several locations / franchise growth
Field crews and paper forms
Loyalty/membership model
Competitors already have an app
disqualifiers: Single small location with low repeat customers
painPointsSolved: Dependence on third-party apps and their fees
items.roi: Owning the ordering/booking channel avoids 15–30% marketplace fees and increases repeat purchases.

pitch.hook: We build the app your customers or your field team actually use — iOS and Android from one codebase, owned by you.
valueProps: You own it — no platform fees
pitch.proof: Weekly builds you can install on your phone and test.

objections.response: Which is why we scope a first phase that pays back on its own — usually ordering or booking — before anything else.

items.name: Website Rebuild — Performance, SEO & Conversion
items.oneLiner: We rebuild slow, outdated websites into fast, SEO-healthy sites that turn visitors into calls and bookings.
items.description: Technical rebuild of the website focused on Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, local SEO structure, conversion (clear CTAs, online booking/quote forms, click-to-call) and analytics. Often the entry point before automation or AI.

idealCustomer.companySize: Any local business with a weak website
idealCustomer.description: Profitable local businesses with a website that looks 2015, loads slowly on mobile or doesn't rank.

buyingSignals: Old copyright year in the footer
Not mobile friendly / very slow
No clear call-to-action or online booking
Strong reviews but weak website (good business, bad online presence)
disqualifiers: Website recently rebuilt by an agency and performing well
painPointsSolved: Losing customers to competitors with better sites
Paying ads that land on a slow page

pricing.notes: Good entry offer; upsell automation / AI receptionist afterwards.

items.roi: Faster mobile pages and clear CTAs typically lift calls/bookings from the same traffic.

pitch.hook: I took a look at your website on my phone — {specificIssue}. That usually costs {niche} real calls every week.
valueProps: Built by engineers, not a template shop
Designed to generate calls and bookings
pitch.proof: We can send a short free audit of your current site before the call.

objections.response: No problem — we can send the audit to whoever manages it. The goal is just that the site brings you business.

items.name: Private AI Assistant over Company Documents
items.oneLiner: A private ChatGPT-style assistant that answers from the company's own documents, policies, contracts and case files — securely.
items.description: Retrieval-augmented AI (private LLM) over the firm's knowledge: contracts, case files, policies, manuals, SOPs, past proposals. Staff ask questions in plain English and get answers with citations. Deployed in the client's cloud with encryption and access control.

idealCustomer.description: Knowledge-heavy firms where staff spend hours searching documents or re-asking senior people the same questions.

buyingSignals: Large document volume (case files, policies, contracts)
Hiring paralegals / analysts / coordinators
Mentions of compliance or quality manuals
Onboarding many new employees
disqualifiers: Very small firm with few documents
painPointsSolved: Data privacy fears with public AI tools
items.roi: If 20 staff save 3 hours/week searching, that's ~3,000 hours/year.

pitch.hook: We build private AI assistants for {niche} that answer from your own files — with citations — without sending your data to public chatbots.
pitch.proof: We start from one concrete use case and only ship if it beats how your team works today.

objections.response: That's the point of a private deployment — it runs in your environment, encrypted, with permissions. Nothing goes to a public chatbot.

items.name: Retail AI — Demand Forecasting & Dynamic Pricing
items.oneLiner: AI models that forecast demand, optimize inventory and adjust prices so the business stops overstocking and running out.
items.description: Forecasting and repricing models trained on the company's sales history, seasonality and catalog, integrated with their e-commerce/POS/ERP. Includes inventory recommendations and pricing rules with guardrails.

idealCustomer.description: Retailers and distributors with enough sales history and SKUs that inventory mistakes are expensive.

buyingSignals: Large catalog on Shopify/WooCommerce/Amazon
Frequent out-of-stock or clearance sales
Hiring inventory planners / buyers
Multiple warehouses or channels
disqualifiers: Tiny catalog or under ~1 year of sales data
items.roi: A few points less overstock on a $1M inventory frees tens of thousands in cash.

pitch.hook: We build forecasting models for {niche} that tell you what to reorder and when — so less cash sits in the warehouse.
valueProps: Only ships if it beats your current method
pitch.proof: We benchmark against your current forecasting before you commit to the next phase.

objections.response: Everyone's is. Phase one is a data audit — you get a clear answer on whether AI is worth it before building anything.

items.name: AI Jewelry Design Studio (Claude + Blender / AutoCAD)
items.oneLiner: An AI design tool that turns a customer's idea, sketch or photo into a 3D jewelry model and photorealistic render in minutes — integrated with Blender / AutoCAD / Rhino workflows.
items.description: Custom design assistant for jewelers: the customer describes the piece (or uploads a sketch/inspiration photo), Claude generates design variations and parametric 3D models through Blender/AutoCAD scripting, renders photorealistic previews for approval, and exports CAD files ready for casting / 3D printing. Cuts custom-design turnaround from days to minutes and closes more custom orders in the first visit.
deliverables: AI design assistant tuned to the jeweler's style
Export to STL/3DM for casting or printing

idealCustomer.companySize: Independent jewelers and small chains (1–30 employees) that sell custom pieces
idealCustomer.description: Jewelers selling custom engagement rings, wedding bands and bespoke pieces, who depend on a CAD designer (in-house or outsourced) and lose sales while customers wait for renders.

buyingSignals: Offers 'custom design', 'bespoke', 'design your own ring' or engagement ring services
Mentions CAD design, 3D printing or in-house casting
Instagram full of custom pieces / renders
Job posts for CAD jewelry designer
Reviews mentioning design process, waiting for renders or multiple revisions
disqualifiers: Pawn shops / gold buyers without design services
painPointsSolved: Days of waiting for CAD renders
Customers who leave to 'think about it'

pricing.notes: Price depends on CAD tool integration and customization.

items.roi: Closing just 2–3 extra custom engagement rings a month (avg. $3k–$6k each) pays for the system quickly.

pitch.hook: We built an AI design tool for jewelers: your customer describes the ring, and in minutes you show them a photorealistic 3D render — while they're still in the store.
valueProps: Close custom orders on the first visit
pitch.proof: We can show a live demo with one of your own pieces as reference.

objections.objection: We already have a CAD designer.
objections.response: Perfect — this makes your designer 5x faster: the AI produces the first variations and renders, your designer refines. Less waiting, more closed sales.
Agreed — it doesn't replace your craft. It shows the customer the idea instantly so they commit; your team still makes the final design.

items.name: Generative Content Pipeline
items.oneLiner: Automated AI pipelines that produce on-brand product descriptions, listings, images and short videos at volume.
items.description: Custom pipelines that generate and publish content at scale: real-estate listing descriptions and virtual staging, e-commerce product copy and images, social posts and short videos — reviewed by humans and kept on brand.

idealCustomer.companySize: Businesses publishing many listings/products every week
idealCustomer.description: Teams that manually write hundreds of listings, product pages or posts.

buyingSignals: Hundreds of listings/products
Hiring content writers / social media coordinators
Inconsistent or missing product descriptions
items.roi: Turns days of copywriting into minutes per batch.

pitch.hook: We build AI pipelines that write and publish your listings/product pages in your brand voice — your team just approves.
pitch.proof: We can generate a sample batch from your own listings.

objections.response: Generic prompts do. We train it on your best-performing listings and your tone, and a human approves every batch.

items.name: Reviews & Customer Sentiment Intelligence
items.oneLiner: AI that reads every review, survey and support ticket across locations and tells management exactly what to fix — plus drafted replies.
items.description: Sentiment analysis across Google, Yelp, TripAdvisor, surveys and tickets, by location and topic, with alerts, weekly executive reports and AI-drafted review responses.

idealCustomer.description: Multi-location brands whose reputation drives revenue and who can't read every review.

buyingSignals: Hundreds/thousands of reviews
Unanswered reviews
Mixed ratings across locations
items.roi: Each star of rating has a direct effect on local revenue; fixing the top recurring complaint pays back quickly.

pitch.hook: We give {niche} with several locations one dashboard that reads every review and tells you what to fix first — and drafts the replies.
pitch.proof: We can run a free snapshot on your last 200 reviews.

objections.objection: We already use a reviews tool.
objections.response: Most tools count stars. This tells you why — by topic and location — and what to fix first.

items.name: Software Rescue & Hardening
items.oneLiner: Audit and fix existing software that's slow, insecure or abandoned by the previous developer — in priority order.
items.description: We audit the existing app (security, performance, architecture, data), deliver a prioritized report and then fix the issues — or take over development as an embedded senior team.

idealCustomer.companySize: Companies running their own custom software
idealCustomer.description: Businesses that depend on custom software built by a freelancer or agency that disappeared, or that's slow and breaking.

buyingSignals: Job posts for a senior developer / CTO
App store reviews complaining about bugs
Very slow web app
Custom platform with no visible tech team

pricing.notes: Audit is a low-risk entry point.

items.roi: Avoids rewrites, outages and security incidents that cost far more.

pitch.hook: If your platform was built by a developer who's no longer around, we audit it, tell you exactly what's risky, and fix it in priority order.
pitch.proof: 15-domain senior engineering audit with a 0–100 scorecard.

objections.response: Usually until it doesn't. The audit is a small fixed fee and tells you whether you have a problem before your customers find it.
